relevance_rank_note: The only APOE-genotyped proteome of living human brain tissue found: cortex biopsies from people with normal pressure hydrocephalus (aged, frequent amyloid). Dataset EV3 gives author-published log2 fold changes and p values for all proteins, including ARF6 itself. Bulk tissue and total protein, so class 3; aged and amyloid-confounded.

quote: Dataset EV3. List of all proteins showing up- or downregulation between apoE43/44 and apoE33/22 genotyped biopsy samples (Related to Fig. 6A).
system: Right frontal cortex biopsies from living patients with idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus, taken at shunt surgery (Kuopio); patients aged 58 to 87. APOE4 carriers (3 E4/4, 5 E3/4; 6 of 8 with Abeta plaques) vs non-carriers (7 E3/3, 2 E2/3; 4 of 9 with plaques). Bulk tissue label-free MS1 proteomics (FragPipe), fold changes and p values from the DEP R package, no multiple-testing correction reported (about 1,940 proteins).
description: ARF6 protein in living human cortex was not higher in APOE4 carriers than non-carriers: log2 fold change -0.093 (about 6% lower), p 0.11. Rawat 2019 found more ARF6 in APOE4 mouse astrocytes; this human tissue shows no increase. Effect detail: the supplement prints log2FC -0.093; the column gives the same value as a linear fold, 2^log2FC.
summary: (non-carriers -> APOE4 carriers, living human cortex) -> (no increase in total ARF6)
human_check: Sign checked against the paper's text: S100B, stated to be higher in apoE33/23 samples, has log2fc -0.469 (p 0.004) in this sheet, so negative = lower in APOE4 carriers. Effect = percent change converted from the printed log2fc. n = 17 (8 carriers, 9 non-carriers; E2/3 pooled with E3/3, as in Cataldo 2000). Aged patients with frequent amyloid, unevenly split by genotype, and p values are unadjusted across about 1,940 proteins. Coded against under the non-significant-trend rule: the H2-supporting result (Rawat 2019's total ARF6 row) is higher ARF6 with APOE4. Bulk tissue mixes all cell types, so an astrocyte-specific change could be diluted.

description: PSD3 (EFA6D), a guanine-nucleotide exchange factor that activates ARF6, was lower in APOE4 carriers' living cortex: log2 fold change -0.141 (about 9% lower), p 0.030. Effect detail: the supplement prints log2FC -0.141; the column gives the same value as a linear fold, 2^log2FC.
summary: (non-carriers -> APOE4 carriers, living human cortex) -> (less total PSD3/EFA6D, an ARF6 activator)

Aged patients with frequent amyloid, unevenly split by genotype, and p values are unadjusted across about 1,940 proteins. Less ARF6 activator would, if anything, mean less ARF6 activity; ARF6 activity was not measured, so not coded against.
